Package org.webharvest

Interface Harvest

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultHarvest
    public interface Harvest
    Web-Harvest application facade that provides control over creation of scraping processors Harvester and dispatching of scraping events.

    2.1.0-SNAPSHOT

    • Method Detail

      • getHarvester

        Harvester getHarvester​(ConfigSource source,
                       HarvestLoadCallback callback)
                throws IOException
        Creates new Harvester object with configuration with configuration represented by ConfigSource object. Throws IOException in case of any problems with reading configuration from remote location.
        Parameters:
        source - the URL from where to get the configuration.
        callback -
        Returns:
        new Harvester instance.
        Throws:
        IOException - problems with reading the configuration.

      • addEventHandler

        void addEventHandler​(EventHandler<?> handler)
        Register event handler. Registered handler will receive events from different scraping scopes.
        Parameters:
        handler - reference to EventHandler.

      • postEvent

        <E extends HarvesterEvent> void postEvent​(E event)
        Post an event with hope it will be routed to target scope. An event object needs to implement or be an ancestor of HarvesterEvent. Event is not propagated to all current scopes. Instead it is sent to a scope associated withurl event's Harvester.
        Type Parameters:
        E - Type of HarvesterEvent event.
        Parameters:
        event - event to publish.
